name: eidetic_devourer
label: The Eidetic Devourer
poeticVision: The player will feel the chilling weight of every shot fired. Each pull of the trigger isn't just expending ammo; it's a silent question: 'Is this memory worth losing to survive this moment?' The fleeting sense of power gained from sacrificing a precious piece of self will be intoxicating, yet tinged with the deep dread of irreversible self-erosion. They'll witness their own past, their own identity, literally dissolve into raw, destructive energy, forced to make agonizing, split-second choices between lethal power and enduring who they are.

parameters.name: weapon_mesh
parameters.description: The MeshInstance3D node representing the weapon's visual model. Its material will be updated by the weapon_material.

parameters.name: projectile_scene
parameters.description: A PackedScene for the projectile fired by the weapon (e.g., a simple sphere with a script).

parameters.name: fire_point
parameters.description: A Node3D representing the origin and direction of fired projectiles.

parameters.name: weapon_material
parameters.description: The ShaderMaterial instance that uses 'eidetic_devourer.gdshader' to visually alter the weapon. This material should also be applied to the weapon_mesh.

dependencies: A PackedScene for the projectile (e.g., a RigidBody3D with MeshInstance3D and CollisionShape3D).
verdict: A weapon forged from the soul's own fragments, it offers power at the price of self, turning every desperate shot into a haunting echo of what once was.
impact: This mechanic will fundamentally alter the player's relationship with combat and their own progression. Every decision to fire a powerful shot becomes a moral and existential dilemma, forcing players to constantly weigh immediate survival against the gradual erosion of their character's very essence. It transforms resource management into a deeply personal and agonizing choice, making each victory feel both earned and costly, imbuing every encounter with profound emotional weight.
